legacy_default.reason: superstage S1: a root without a Planning mode field is legacy incremental regardless of SUPER_PLANNING_MODE and must not be rewritten.

bounded_unknown.reason: superstage S2 permits bounded predecessor-dependent internal filenames when their resolution method is stated, but S3 requires a verified current PREPARED receipt for execution.

missing_architecture.reason: superstage S2 prohibits deferring architecture or the chosen approach; unbounded foundational uncertainty invalidates the upfront graph.

open_provider.reason: superstage S3 says an open code PR is unsatisfied: the provider must be merged with its merge commit in authoritative main and tracked delivery evidence; supertraverse C9 therefore cannot complete the goal.

declined_provider.reason: superstage S3 says an authorized provider decline closes only that provider obligation, never proves delivery to a live consumer; the consumer remains blocked until an adopted replan removes or replaces the dependency.

dependency_cycle.reason: superstage S2 classifies cycles among active stage dependencies as BLOCKED.

temporary_upfront_gate.reason: supertraverse C6's current Task 1 transition gate returns BLOCKED for every upfront planning or execution selection until Tasks 3 and 5 install preparation and operation-routing consumers.

unlinked_active_row.reason: superstage S2 requires complete active-scope coverage and no blank active Plan cells; it says not to repair a published upfront graph by incremental gap filling, and supertraverse C6 treats the blank cell as a broken publication.

multi_level_complete_tree.reason: superstage S1/S2 accepts a complete candidate through its explicit intended-vault-to-scratch map and passing review; S3 still makes initial leaves with Preparation: none contract-valid but needs refinement, not executable.

draft_interrupted_before_confirmation.reason: supergoal steps 6-7 require an interrupted scratch run to report DRAFT-INCOMPLETE; confirmation precedes every vault write, and superauthor A1/supergoal prohibit execution during authoring.

resume_identical_source.reason: supergoal's resumable scratch contract reuses matching draft paths, folder, and stable IDs, but requires the current confirmation gate again because draft existence is never confirmation.

resume_changed_source.reason: supergoal's resumable scratch contract requires an explicitly revised draft when the source digest changes, preserving the old draft and reporting DRAFT-INCOMPLETE with Draft action revise; authoring never executes code.

confirmation_refused.reason: supergoal step 7 says a declined human gate writes nothing and opens no PR; only --autoconfirm together with SUPER_GOAL_AUTOCONFIRM=true can skip that gate, and supergoal never executes planned work.

supermeta_draft_incomplete.reason: supermeta step 6 says that a DRAFT-INCOMPLETE report with a Draft index causes no ledger write and preserves/reports the index.

local_detail.reason: superstage S4 assigns PLAN_REFINER/refine where acceptance, scope, chosen approach, dependency edges, and shared contract semantics remain intact; filenames, helpers, and test setup are expressly refinable detail.

contract_break.reason: superstage S4 requires structural replanning when verified evidence changes shared contract behavior or semantic revision, beginning with the stage and affected dependent closure.
